Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Sewing Premium Full Rigged Sail
Skill Reqs : Sewing Rank 15
Ingredients : Main Full Rigged Sail + 5x Strange Sail + Specially Fashioned Rope

Stats : 70/70 Durability, +26 Vertical Sail, +29 Horizontal Sail, -1 TS penalty.

comments.body: Bumping this thread, players have been asking me about the recipes required, you can see that as the player posted the recipe above.
